config.name: dev2P-P2scrS1-F0
config.note: dev2P: P2scrS1 = PET2-small scratch at step 1 (declared PET2 recipe) + C's step 2 with pdg_onehot, efficiency-corrected misses, K=5; step1_iteration_lr=constant, step2_iteration_lr=constant; base C 0afffb7d4402; pool F replicate 0 (predecessor-drawn), seed 1553938054; generated by final_design/pet2/make_pet2_configs.py

distortion.name: dev
distortion.form: exp(A*clip((E-p50)/IQR, -Z, +Z)) / mean over the pseudodata's truth-passing rows

reco_coverage.criterion: every pass_reco row must have a built input. Rows without reco have no reconstructed object to build a token from and are zeroed for BOTH arms, exactly as the production loader zeroes ours

tilt_spec.name: dev
tilt_spec.form: exp(A*clip((E-p50)/IQR, -Z, +Z)) / mean over the pseudodata's truth-passing rows
tilt_spec.applied_on: pass_truth rows of the pseudodata only
